newsitem.title: UK: Costain declines comment on U.S.coal sale.
newsitem.headline: Costain declines comment on U.S.coal sale.

text.p: Troubled British construction company Costain Plc on Sunday declined comment on press reports that it was in weekend talks to tie up the sale of its U.S. coal operations.
However, at least two senior staff were at the central London headquarters on Sunday afternoon.
The Sunday Times said if a deal is completed, it could be accompanied by a statement setting out Costain's survival plan.
The paper reported that the company has been seeking king a buyer for its coal business since July when Lonrho decided not to pursue a purchase of the coal business for 50 million stg.
Shares in Costain were suspended on November 7 pending clarification into its financial positions.
